metadata.title: जम्मू-कश्मीर में पहाड़ी कैसे बने आदिवासी? | How Pahari became Scheduled tribe in Jammu and Kashmir
metadata.description: The Union introduced the Constitution (Jammu and Kashmir) Scheduled Tribes Order (Amendment) Bill in the Lok Sabha, proposing to grant Scheduled Tribe status to the Pahari linguistic minority in Jammu and Kashmir. If passed, this would be the first instance of tribal status being given to a linguistic group. However, this move has caused resentment among the Gujjar and Bakerwal tribes, who fear that it could adversely affect their interests. The contentious bill has sparked a heated debate over tribal identity and rights in the region
